description: Mutate a SwOS '.b' endpoint on a MikroTik switch. The full endpoint blob is read, the given fields are merged in, and the entire blob is written back (the firmware only accepts whole-blob writes); untouched fields are re-sent byte-for-byte, and a field this firmware does not expose is refused rather than injected. dryRun defaults to true — preview first. Every result reports whether the schema has been verified against the switch's firmware. The pre-write blob is snapshotted, so the change can be undone with rollback_change. Returns no_change when the values already match.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Preview the resulting blob without writing to the switch.

fields.description: Values to set, keyed by decoded field name (from list_swos_endpoints) or by a raw wire key already present in the blob — anything else is rejected. Option fields take the enum name (e.g. 'auto'); text becomes a UTF-8 hex string; numbers and '0x...' strings are written as hex, padded to the width of the value they replace. A per-port field given a single value applies it to EVERY port.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: write_swos_blob
title: Write SwOS Blob
